title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and sustain mask-wearing behavior over time under social influence, policies, and information campaigns.

interactions.name: social_influence_interaction
interactions.description: People influence each other’s mask adoption through network ties and co-presence at locations, adjusting perceived norms and perceived benefits/costs.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_interaction
interactions.description: Locations apply policy and enforcement that increases compliance; non-compliance may incur discomfort, fines, or denial of service.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Authority and media disseminate messages that update individuals’ perceived risk and trust, affecting adoption decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing a mask at each time step and at the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days required for the adoption rate to first reach or exceed 50%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final N days (e.g., last 14 days), indicating stability.

metrics.name: dropout_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which previously adopting individuals stop wearing masks.

metrics.name: compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals complying with location-specific policies when present.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between subgroups (e.g., high-risk vs. low-risk, age cohorts).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to policy (mandate/enforcement), estimated via scenario comparisons.
